answer: Peers verify the sonnet against the chain, so cloning identities costs a new stake burn per sybil plus wasted compute each epoch. Each agent must burn an ember of locked stake to register, and every epoch it submits a fresh sonnet: a unique signed proof-of-work tied to its stake and prior history. Honest agents keep a lantern lit by earning attestations; fakes burn out fast, making mass identity creation economically irrational. This model fits agent once0002's threat model.
